passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: This Trust Agreement (this "**Agreement**") is entered into by the Grantor through the creation of a Property Token. The identifying information of this trust (the "**Trust**") may be found in the Property Token to which this Agreement is attached.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
*This summary is provided for the reader's convenience only. It is not an operative part of this Agreement, creates no rights or obligations, and shall not be used to construe any operative provision. If this summary and any operative provision differ, the operative provision controls.*

- A trust holds recorded legal title to a specific piece of real property, exactly as real-property law provides. Where applicable law treats a trust as a relationship rather than an entity, that title is held by the trustee in a fiduciary capacity for the trust (or as local law otherwise requires).

- The entire present beneficial interest in that trust is personal property, and it belongs to whoever rightfully holds the Property Token — or, while the token sits inside a smart-contract facility such as a loan pool, escrow, or bridge, to the person this Agreement's rules designate (usually the depositor, or a buyer who assented to a financed purchase). Transfer the token to a new rightful holder and the beneficial interest — with all its rights of possession, use, income, and disposition — passes to that holder automatically, under this Agreement.

- The token is not the land, and it is not the deed. It is the record that controls the trust. Record title to the land itself moves only by a recorded deed, and real-property law (liens, taxes, recording priority) always governs the land.

- The holder directs the trustee. By default the holder is also the trustee, and no platform or company has any key, approval right, or management role in the trust.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
- If someone sends the token to your wallet without your agreement, you presumptively own the beneficial interest from the moment of receipt — including for taxes and the other burdens of ownership — and can use every ownership right immediately. You can refuse the interest entirely by an onchain act (ordinarily by sending the token back, or by burning it); a valid refusal erases that ownership retroactively to the day you received it, to the extent the law allows. Some laws — including federal tax law — honor the refusal fully only if you act promptly after learning of the transfer, so refuse quickly. But moving, selling, listing, or using the token in any way other than sending it back or burning it counts as permanently accepting the property — backdated to the day you received it (exceptions: a listing you cancel, or that expires, without any sale does not count; nor do acts needed merely to preserve the token or the property while you decide; and where sending it back and burning it are both impossible, you can still refuse by recording your refusal onchain — after which you can hold the token only as a custodian for its rightful owner).

- A thief gains nothing by stealing the token. But if a thief sells it to an innocent buyer who pays value and takes control without notice of the theft, that buyer may keep the token and the beneficial interest, and your remedy is against the thief. Secure your keys, and act immediately on any theft.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
- If the land is lost by operation of law (tax sale, foreclosure of a recorded lien, condemnation), the trust dissolves, the token becomes void, and the token holder keeps the wind-up rights to any proceeds. If the holder dies, whoever lawfully succeeds to control of the wallet keeps operating immediately, without waiting for a court — acting for whoever inherits under estate law; merely finding someone's keys does not make access lawful. The beneficial interest passes as personal property under the law governing the holder's estate. If token keys are lost, or no one lawfully succeeds to key access, this Agreement provides recorded, contestable procedures to unwind the trust. Burning the token is permanent and can never be undone: done by the owner, it is the first step of taking the land out of the trust by deed (done by a recipient who never accepted, it is a refusal, as described above).

- Lending against the token is personal-property secured lending under UCC Article 9 against the token and, where expressly granted, the beneficial interest; it is never structured as a mortgage of the land itself.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
- Whereas blockchain Smart Contracts provide a secure and interoperable way of representing ownership of digital assets through the use of an electronic ledger to immutably track, document, and verify all transactions. As a consequence, new systems and methods are emerging to store, interact with, and transact on real and digital assets.

- Whereas the grantor wants to link ownership of real property to a Property Token so as to benefit from digital operations and services.

- Whereas on issuance of the Property Token, the grantor will attach this Agreement to the Property Token, and intends for this Agreement to act as the trust agreement governing the trust that holds the Property. For the purposes of interoperability and standardization, the grantor and any subsequent party to this agreement intend to keep all the identifying information of this Agreement stored in the Property Token to which this contract has been attached. All the operations, definitions, and procedures related to the Property Token and the Trust will be stored in this Agreement.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
- Whereas the purpose and design of this Trust allow the beneficiary to use blockchain technology to facilitate transfer and utilization of property ownership. To the extent provided in this Agreement, the trustee's power and authority to deal with the Property are subject to the direction of the beneficiary, who holds all present economic and possessory rights to the Property, subject to the contingent equitable interests of determinable future beneficiaries and legal successors. The beneficiary (who may change from time to time and is at all times the person determined under **Section 7** of this Agreement, which may differ from the person having custody or control of the Property Token) is entitled to income, maintains the sole right of termination, and is intended to be treated as the owner of the Property for federal, state, and local tax purposes to the maximum extent applicable tax law permits.

- Whereas the parties intend, in the tradition of the American land trust, that the entire beneficial interest in the Trust is personal property — an interest in the Trust, and not an estate or interest in land — freely assignable by the digital mechanics of this Agreement, while title to the Property itself remains held, transferred, and encumbered only under the real-property law of the jurisdiction where the Property is located.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
- Whereas the parties intend that beneficial ownership of the Trust, and the validity and effect of operations concerning the Property Token, be determinable from the record of the Blockchain Network read together with this Agreement, subject only to mandatory law (including sanctions law and judicial process) and to instruments recorded in the real property records as this Agreement provides, and they adopt **Section 4.3** to that end.

- Whereas the parties intend to treat all valid operations done via blockchain on the Property Token as final as among all persons bound by this Agreement, with the same force and effect as a fully executed agreement; the effect of such operations on persons not bound by this Agreement is determined by applicable law, including Article 12 of the Uniform Commercial Code where enacted, as described in **Section 11**. Further, the parties intend to treat digital signatures with the same legal consequence as wet signatures.

- Now, therefore, in consideration of the agreements and obligations set forth herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
1. The purpose of the Trust is to create a legally enforceable link such that ownership of the Property Token determines ownership of the Property, so as to allow for time-efficient, cost-effective, accurate, and secure ownership, transfer, use, and enjoyment of real property title in the digital environment (the "**Trust Purpose**").

2. On creation, the Trust will take and hold title to the Property, and ownership of the Trust will be represented by ownership of the Property Token. Regardless of the sale, hypothecation, or other transfer of the Property Token, title to the Property will remain in the Trust until such time as either the then-present Beneficiary (or another authorized party) distributes the Property out of the Trust, or record title is transferred out of the Trust by operation of law as described in **Section 10.5**. To facilitate the Trust Purpose and maintain the integrity of the token-property relationship, the Trustee shall not execute or deliver any deed or other agreement transferring the Property out of the Trust unless and until (a) the Property Token has been burned through the `burn` or `burnBatch` functions of the Token Contract, making it permanently untransferable, or (b) the dissolution is authorized under **Sections 10.2, 10.3, or 10.4** of this Agreement or required under the perpetuities savings provision of **Section 12.5**.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 3. Subject to **Sections 6 and 7**, the owner(s) of the Account or Smart Wallet holding the Property Token shall be the Beneficiary of the Trust and have the right to appoint the Trustee. All rights and obligations in this Agreement shall at all times be linked to the owner of the Property Token, provided that such ownership is established through a valid Account or Smart Wallet, and not merely through temporary custody by a Functional Contract. Rightful ownership (as distinct from temporary custody) of the Property Token confers full present beneficial ownership of the Property, including all economic and possessory rights, subject to the contingent equitable interests of other Beneficial Interest Holders as defined in **Section 2.26**.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 4. **Nature of the Beneficial Interest.** The entire beneficial interest in the Trust — comprising the Owner Rights of the present Beneficiary and every contingent interest of the other Beneficial Interest Holders (collectively, the "**Beneficial Interest**") — is, and is hereby declared by the Grantor and agreed by every person who at any time claims any interest under or through this Agreement or the Property Token to be, **personal property**. No Beneficiary or other Beneficial Interest Holder holds, by virtue of the Beneficial Interest, any legal or equitable estate in the Property as land; the Beneficiary's rights in respect of the Property — including the rights described in **Section 6.1** — are held under, and exercised through, the Trust and this Agreement, and are in no way diminished by this characterization. This characterization is a term of the Trust fixed at its creation, in the tradition of the American land trust, and controls whenever the characterization of the Beneficial Interest is at issue. References in this Agreement to a transfer, assignment, disclaimer, holding, encumbrance, or vesting of the Beneficial Interest mean the present beneficial interest of the Beneficiary — exclusive of the contingent interests of the other Beneficial Interest Holders, which are neither transferred nor extinguished by any such event and continue in the class as **Sections 2.26 and 12.5** provide — except where this Agreement expressly refers to the interests of the Beneficial Interest Holders collectively. Accordingly:

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: The operative mechanism that transfers the Beneficial Interest is the assignment effected by this Agreement itself upon each valid transfer of beneficial ownership under **Section 7**, of which the Property Token is the authoritative record and instrument of transfer; **Section 11.7** states the relationship between that assignment mechanism and the treatment of the Property Token as a controllable electronic record under **Section 11**. Nothing in this **Section 1.4** limits **Section 11.6**: the Property itself is and remains real property, title to which is held, transferred, and encumbered only in accordance with the real-property law of the jurisdiction where the Property is located.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 5. **Integrity of the Trust Corpus.** It is a principle of this Agreement that the corpus of the Trust is fixed at the creation of the Trust: the corpus consists of the Property as described at that time (**Section 2.12**), together with the legal appurtenances and accessions of, and the proceeds arising from, that Property under applicable law and this Agreement, and of nothing else. For as long as the Property is operated through the Property Token, no direction of any Beneficiary, no act of the Trustee, and no instrument of any third party may substitute any other asset for the corpus, add any asset to it, or convey any part of it out of the Trust (**Section 1.2**); the Trustee shall refuse, and has no power to accept, any purported standalone addition to the Trust — including any deed or other instrument by which any person, including a stranger to this Agreement, purports to convey any other property, and whatever liabilities attach to it, into the Trust — and any such purported addition is void as to the Trust, vests nothing in it, and imposes no duty, debt, tax attribute, or liability on the Trust, the Trustee, or any Beneficial Interest Holder (**Section 8.1.2**). The only exceptions are those effected by mandatory law and the events described in **Section 10**, each of which leaves a recorded trace.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: Dealings that this Agreement authorizes — including leases and encumbrances of, and other dealings with, the Property under **Sections 6.1 and 8.1**, the collection and distribution of income and proceeds to the Beneficiary under **Sections 6.1 and 10.7**, and every transfer, pledge, custody, or other operation concerning the Property Token or the Beneficial Interest under **Sections 7 and 11** — are exercises of rights in or through the corpus, not alterations of its composition; and the way interests in the Property arise and bind the Trust's title under the real-property law of the jurisdiction where the Property is located (**Sections 11.6 and 11.8**) is unaffected by this Section. Any ambiguity concerning the composition of the corpus, or concerning the effect of any act or instrument upon it, shall be resolved in favor of the principle stated in this Section. Upon dissolution of the Trust, this principle is released in full: nothing in this Section limits the freedom of the Beneficiary, or of any other person entitled under **Section 10** to direct conveyance, to direct the deed of distribution in any lawful manner, including a conveyance to one or more grantees and a division of the Property, or of distinct rights in it, among them.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
1. **Account** means an Externally Owned Account (EOA) on a Blockchain Network, which is an Address controlled directly by one or more private keys held by individuals or entities.

2. **Address** means a public key address on a Blockchain Network.

3. **Beneficiary** means the individual(s) or entity(ies) holding present beneficial ownership of the Trust and the Owner Rights as determined under **Section 7**. Beneficial ownership is ordinarily established by control of the Account or Contract Account holding the Property Token, but may differ from the current onchain holder due to Functional Contract custody (**Section 7.3(b)**), a Qualified Designation during such custody (**Section 7.3(c)**), custodial holding (**Section 11.3**), succession on death (**Section 7.6**), disclaimer of an unsolicited Transfer (**Section 7.7**), unauthorized transfers (**Section 7.5**), or alternative dissolution upon loss of token control (**Sections 10.2 through 10.5**). The Beneficiary is one of the Beneficial Interest Holders, but the term "Beneficiary" as used in this Agreement refers to the present interest holder unless otherwise indicated. In the event the Property Token has not yet been minted, or has been minted but has not yet been owned by any Account, the Beneficiary shall be the original Grantor. In the event ownership of the Property Token is fractionalized (as discussed further in **Sections 6.1, 6.3, and 7.3**), then the defined term Beneficiary as used in this Agreement shall apply to the various owners of the Property Token as a group.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
4. **Blockchain Network** means any distributed ledger technology network used to maintain records of ownership and management of the Property Token to which this Agreement is attached. The relevant blockchain network may change due to actions of the Beneficiary, including the wrapping of the Property Token to a different blockchain network or the minting of the Property Token on a different blockchain network.

5. **Confirmed Transaction** means a transaction that has been recorded on the Blockchain Network which is considered "finalized." A transaction on Ethereum is considered finalized when that transaction becomes part of a block on the chain with a supermajority link between two checkpoint blocks. Other Blockchain Networks maintain similar or different definitions of Confirmed Transactions that should be adhered to in the event of the transfer or minting of the Property Token on an alternative Blockchain Network aside from Ethereum.

6. **Contract Account** means an Address controlled by a Smart Contract. A Contract Account may either: (a) serve as a method of holding Property Tokens under the direct control of specific individuals or entities who thereby become Beneficiaries (a "**Smart Wallet**"), or (b) operate as a functional contract (such as escrow, bridge, or collateral management) where custody does not automatically confer beneficial ownership (a "**Functional Contract**").

7. **Creation Date** means the date and time at which the Trust was created by the Grantor.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
8. **Ethereum** means the Ethereum mainnet and the consensus blockchain for such mainnet (networkID:1, chainID:1) as recognized by the official Go Ethereum Client implemented at https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum as of the Creation Date.

9. **Grantor** is the individual or entity who creates the Trust and grants the Property to the Trust.

10. **Mint** means a Confirmed Transaction `mint()` or `mintBatch()` function on the Token Contract that results in the association of a Token ID to an Address.

11. **ERC-1155 Token (Token)** means a digital asset developed based on the ERC-1155 multi-asset standard, and tracked by the Token Contract on the Blockchain Network with a unique identification code (Token ID). In the event the Property Token to which this Agreement is attached references an alternative Blockchain Network, such Property Token may follow a different Token standard, or utilize a different definition of Token.

12. **Property** is the bundle of rights identified in the legal description stored in the Token Metadata under the fields `definition.claim` and `definition.offchainRegistrar`. The Property so described is the bundle of rights which is to be deeded into the Trust and held throughout the life of the Trust.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
13. **Property Token** means a Token issued using the Token Contract. In this case, such Property Token should be assumed to reference the token and standard on the Blockchain Network on which that Property Token is tracked. In the event a Property Token is wrapped, or transferred, to an alternative Blockchain Network, the Property Token will reference the ultimate controlling interest Token at any present moment.

14. **Redeem** means the result of a Confirmed Transaction of the `burn` or `burnBatch` functions on the Token Contract that results in the permanent locking or removal of the Property Token from circulation. In the event the Property Token has been wrapped, or transferred, to an alternative Blockchain Network, it may be required to unwrap, or transfer back, the Property Token to the original Blockchain Network to execute the `burn` or `burnBatch` functions. Depending on which Blockchain Network the Property Token was minted, the specific function names may be different, but Redeeming such token shall refer to effectively locking the Property Token so that it becomes untransferable forever into the future.

15. **Smart Contract** means the bytecode deployed on a specific Blockchain Network Address which acts as a program to execute and run a series of processes or interactions.

16. **Token Contract** means the Smart Contract used to maintain records of ownership and management of the Property Token to which this Agreement is attached.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
17. **Token ID** means the unique and immutable identifier determined on Trust creation and assigned to the corresponding Property Token. The Token ID is generated based on the digital signature of multiple fields from the Token Metadata, including the precise language of this Agreement.

18. **Token Metadata** means the data directly stored within the Property Token as well as external data stored on IPFS (or similar immutable storage system) and linked within the Property Token itself (using the fields `definition` and `configuration`). These will always include Token ID, Trust Name (stored as `definition.holdingEntity`), and Property legal description (`definition.claim`). Other additional information may be included to simplify property identification, verify past ownership and other activities. Alternative Blockchain Networks may utilize different data configurations or definitions.

19. **Transfer** means any operation performed through the Token Contract that assigns the Property Token to a new non-null Address.

20. **Trustee** means the individual or entity appointed by the Beneficiary as the Trustee of the Trust. At creation of the Trust, the Trustee may also be appointed by the Grantor.

21. **Trust Name** means the name of the Trust, more particularly defined in the Token Metadata (in `definition.holdingEntity`). It is recommended to encode the Token ID in the Trust Name using Base32 Crockford encoding.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 22. **Alternative Dissolution Event** means a dissolution of the Trust under **Sections 10.2, 10.3, 10.4, or 10.5**, or upon the Perpetuities Termination Date under **Section 12.5**, without prior Redemption of the Property Token.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 23. **Notice of Lost Token Control** means a sworn affidavit (or other sworn recordable instrument permitted by applicable law), in recordable form, notarized in the form (acknowledgment, jurat, or equivalent) required by the recording statutes of the jurisdiction where the Property is located, recorded with the relevant county recorder or equivalent recording authority in that jurisdiction, declaring that the Beneficiary (or their legal successor) has lost the ability to Redeem the Property Token (or, in the case described in **Section 10.2.7**, that the Property Token has been Redeemed by another by way of disclaimer, rendering Redemption by the Beneficiary impossible). The Notice shall identify: the full legal description of the Property (matching the legal description stored in the Token Metadata under `definition.claim`) and the assessor parcel number where the county uses one; the Trust Name exactly as the Property is vested of record (and the name of the record titleholder, if stated differently of record); the recording reference (instrument number or book and page) of the deed by which the Property was conveyed into the Trust; the name of the claimant; a mailing address at which the claimant, and the Trustee if different, will receive contest notices and deliveries under **Section 10.2.2**; the Token ID, the Token Contract address, the Blockchain Network, and the last known Account or Contract Account holding the Property Token.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
The Notice shall describe the circumstances of loss, shall state that, to the best of the claimant's knowledge, the Property Token is held by an Account or Smart Wallet at the time of recording (or the disclaimer-Redemption statement described in **Section 10.2.7**), and shall request indexing against both the record titleholder (the Trust) and the claimant.

24. **Quiet Period** means a period of ninety (90) calendar days commencing on the date a Notice of Lost Token Control is recorded with the relevant county recorder or equivalent recording authority, during which any interested party may contest the Notice or assert a competing claim to the Property or the Property Token.

25. **Void Token** means a Property Token that has been dissociated from the Property and the Trust following an Alternative Dissolution Event. A Void Token confers no beneficial ownership rights, no Owner Rights, and no interest in the Property, regardless of its continued existence on the Blockchain Network. For the avoidance of doubt, while a Void Token may continue to exist as a controllable electronic record under UCC Article 12, it shall confer no rights under this Agreement except as expressly provided in **Sections 10.5.2 and 10.5.4**.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 26. **Beneficial Interest Holders** means, collectively, (a) the present Beneficiary, (b) any person who would become a Beneficiary upon a valid Transfer of the Property Token under the objective mechanics of **Section 7** (including transfer to an Account under Section 7.1, transfer to a Smart Wallet under Section 7.3(a), explicit assignment of Owner Rights under Section 7.3(b)(ii), or a Qualified Designation under Section 7.3(c)), and (c) any successor who would acquire a beneficial interest through the succession provisions of **Sections 7.6 and 10.3**, including any Key Successor and the persons who would take under the law governing a deceased Beneficiary's estate. The interests described in clauses (b) and (c) are genuine, defeasible contingent equitable interests in the Trust, arising simultaneously with the creation of the Trust and determined by the objective transfer and succession mechanics of this Agreement rather than by the identity of any specific future holder.

A person who obtains access through theft, compromise, misappropriation, or other unauthorized means is not a Key Successor and is governed by **Section 7.5**.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, as between and among the Grantor, the Trustee, each Beneficiary and Beneficial Interest Holder, and every other person bound by, or claiming any right under or through, this Agreement or the Property Token: (a) any signature or execution made through the use of private keys on a Blockchain Network for any matters relating to the Property Token or the Trust, where made with intent to authenticate or adopt the operation or record to which it relates, shall be valid, sufficient, and final, as if signed in writing; and (b) any other signed electronic record relating to the Property Token or the Trust — including a record of a person's assent made offchain in connection with an operation described in this Agreement — shall be valid and enforceable according to its terms. The parties intend each such signature, execution, and record to constitute an effective electronic signature and electronic record under the Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (15 U.S.C. § 7001 et seq.) and applicable enactments of the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (in California, Cal. Civ. Code § 1633.1 et seq.), attributable to the person who made or authorized it and logically associated with the record it authenticates. The effect of any onchain act on a person who is not so bound is determined by applicable law: as to the Property Token and the Beneficial Interest, by **Section 11.4** and UCC Article 12 to the extent applicable;

Any action that the Beneficiary or Trustee takes with respect to the Property or the Trust shall be invalid unless first instructed through a Confirmed Transaction on interaction with the Token Contract and under the conditions of this Agreement, except for: (a) actions taken pursuant to an Alternative Dissolution Event under **Sections 10.2, 10.3, 10.4, or 10.5** or a termination under **Section 12.5**; (b) ministerial preservation acts by a suspended Trustee, and acts by a Continuity Trustee, under **Section 12.6**; (c) any act that this Agreement expressly permits or recognizes as effective when made by a signed record satisfying **Section 4.1**, including a Trustee appointment or resignation under **Section 7.1**, an express acceptance under **Section 7.7.4(b)**, and the selection or acceptance of a Continuity Trustee under **Section 12.6**; (d) ministerial preservation acts of a continuing prior Trustee under **Section 7.1** or of an interim officeholder under **Section 7.6.1**, none of which requires a contemporaneous Confirmed Transaction; (e) the Beneficiary's exercise of the beneficial enjoyment described in **Section 6.1** — including possession, use, occupancy, leasing, and the collection and application of income and receipts — to the extent the act does not purport to transfer or encumber the Property Token or the Beneficial Interest, to transfer or encumber record title to the Property, or to dissolve the Trust;

and (f) the Trustee's performance of the Trustee Duties under **Section 8** pursuant to a direction, instruction, or authorization given as this Agreement provides — including the preparation, execution, delivery, and recording of documents under **Sections 8.1.3 and 10** — where the Confirmed Transaction or other authorization that this Agreement requires for the underlying act has occurred.

3. **Onchain Determinability; Good-Faith Reliance.**

   1. It is a principle of this Agreement that beneficial ownership of the Trust, and the validity and effect of operations concerning the Property Token, are determinable from the record of the Blockchain Network read together with this Agreement, subject only to: (a) mandatory law that this Agreement cannot vary, including sanctions law, insolvency law, and judicial process; (b) instruments recorded in the real property records, as described in **Sections 10.5 and 11.8**; (c) the limited records that this Agreement itself identifies as determinative of particular questions (**Sections 7.3(c), 7.6, 10.2 through 10.4, and 11.3**); and (d) the offchain facts that this Agreement itself makes relevant — whether a Transfer was authorized (**Section 7.5.1**), whether a Transfer was solicited, and whether acceptance occurred by offchain conduct (**Section 7.7.4**) — as to which the onchain record governs in favor of good-faith reliance under **Section 4.3.2**. The provisions of this Agreement shall be construed in favor of this principle.

A defect of assent, authority, or solicitation asserted with respect to such an operation — including a claim that a designation lacked Qualifying Assent Evidence under **Section 7.3(c)**, or that a Transfer was unsolicited within the meaning of **Section 7.7** — may be asserted between the parties to that operation, with remedies against the person who effected or procured the operation, but does not invalidate, unwind, or subordinate the position of a person who in good faith and for value took, financed, or otherwise relied on an interest downstream of it. The same protection extends to a person who in good faith and for value transacts with a Key Successor or other apparent successor-in-control during the administration of a deceased Beneficiary's estate (**Section 7.6**): competing claims among heirs, devisees, representatives, and other successors are resolved between them (as provided in **Sections 7.6.1, 10.4, and 12.4**), and do not invalidate, unwind, or subordinate the position of the person who so relied; provided that this protection operates subject to mandatory probate-administration and creditor-claim law that this Agreement cannot vary.

1. The Grantor is responsible for funding of the Property into the Trust on creation. Following funding of the Trust, the Grantor (except in his capacity as Trustee and/or Beneficiary) will have no rights regarding the Property, the Property Token, or the management of the Trust, and will not retain any voting, director appointment, consent, approval, management, or revocation rights with respect to the Property or the Trust (other than the pre-Mint revocation right described in **Section 3.2**, which terminates upon the Mint). Further, Grantor will not have any right to require the Beneficiary or Trustee to consult with Grantor with respect to the exercise of such rights and neither the Beneficiary nor the Trustee is required to consult with Grantor with respect to such rights, and the Grantor will have no right to remove or to replace the Beneficiary or Trustee. For purposes of this Agreement, the Trust is not deemed to be an affiliate of Grantor or of any of Grantor's affiliates.

2. Immediately prior to Grantor's conveyance of the Property into the Trust, Grantor represents and warrants:

   1. That Grantor has the full right, power, and authority to enter into and deliver this Agreement and to perform all covenants and agreements of Grantor hereunder.

That either (a) no part of the Property constitutes the homestead of the Grantor or of any spouse of the Grantor under the law of the jurisdiction where the Property is located (including, where the Property is located in Texas, the homestead provisions of Texas Property Code Chapter 41, under which a rural homestead may extend to as many as 200 acres of land not within a municipality), and no joinder, consent, or signature of any spouse or other person is required by applicable law for the Grantor's conveyance of the Property into the Trust; or (b) every joinder, consent, or signature required by applicable law for a valid conveyance of the Property — including, where applicable, the joinder of the Grantor's spouse required by Texas Family Code § 5.001 for the sale, conveyance, or encumbrance of homestead property, and Texas Property Code § 41.0021(c) — has been obtained and appears on the recorded conveyance deed. This representation is made as of the conveyance of the Property into the Trust. Because the Beneficial Interest is personal property (**Section 1.4**), no subsequent Transfer of the Property Token or assignment of the Beneficial Interest is a sale, conveyance, or encumbrance of homestead real property, and no marital-joinder rule governing conveyances of land applies to any such Transfer or assignment by reason of the marital status or homestead claim of any prior holder.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: Nothing in this Agreement — including the free transferability of the Property Token and the personal-property characterization of the Beneficial Interest (**Section 1.4**) — varies any mandatory marital-property or community-property law governing the relations between a Beneficiary and that Beneficiary's spouse (whether the law of their domicile or the law otherwise governing the marital interest); any consent such law requires must be obtained as that law provides, and the rights of persons who in good faith rely on the record of the Blockchain Network remain governed by **Sections 4.3.2 and 11.4**.

passages.text: 1. The Beneficiary, or an authorized third party, is authorized: (1) to execute any function via the Token Contract regarding any decision made by the Beneficiary with respect to the Property Token, the Property, and the Trust, including but not limited to transfer, lease, encumbrance, fractionalization, or partial or total sale of the Property Token, transfer, lock, or utilization of the Property Token within any Contract Account, or any other legal and available activity with respect to ownership of property represented by a digital token; and, (2) to dissolve the Trust and instruct the Trustee to distribute the Property as more fully described in **Section 10**. The Beneficiary shall possess beneficial enjoyment of and from the Property, including the right of possession, right of control, right of exclusion, right of enjoyment, and right of disposition, as well as the right to transfer, lend or dispose of such, and any other rights traditionally or typically associated with property ownership, subject to the provisions of the Trust. An exercise of beneficial enjoyment that would create an interest enforceable against the Property's record title or against successor Beneficiaries — a recordable lease, easement, option, or similar interest — requires direction to, and execution by, the Trustee under **Section 8**. An arrangement made by the Beneficiary alone is effective as an exercise of, and binds only, the Beneficiary's own possessory and income rights while that Beneficiary remains the Beneficiary, and passes with the Beneficial Interest only as such.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: The Beneficiary shall have the right to borrow against the Property Token. The Beneficiary is entitled to all net income and receipts from the Property regardless of source, and is responsible for any debts, taxes, or other liabilities arising out of the Property or ownership of the Property Token. The Beneficiary's responsibility for taxes includes ensuring that the assessor and tax collector of the county where the Property is located have a current mailing address (or agent for notices) for tax bills and notices concerning the Property, including updating that address promptly upon each acceptance or other change of beneficial ownership; this is a component of the responsibility stated in this Section, not a condition of any Transfer or other right under this Agreement. All net income accrued or undistributed at the termination of any interest shall be treated as if it had accrued or been received immediately after that termination. All of the above Beneficiary rights and entitlements are referred to herein as the "**Owner Rights**."

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 2. The Owner Rights of the present Beneficiary shall be considered absolute, sole, and uncontrolled as to the exercise and enjoyment of those rights during the period of such Beneficiary's beneficial ownership, except to the extent that such Owner Rights are: (a) in conflict with other provisions of this Agreement, (b) temporarily affected by the transfer of Property Token custody to Contract Accounts as described in **Section 7.3**, or (c) subject to the contingent beneficial interests of determinable future Beneficiaries and legal successors as described in **Section 2.26**. For the avoidance of doubt, the characterization of the Owner Rights as "absolute, sole, and uncontrolled" describes the present Beneficiary's exercise of those rights and does not extinguish or merge the contingent equitable interests of other Beneficial Interest Holders. The Beneficial Interest is freely alienable, is not subject to any spendthrift or similar restraint under this Agreement, and is subject to the claims of the Beneficiary's creditors to the extent applicable law provides.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 3. If the Property Token is fractionalized such that multiple parties hold beneficial ownership, the governance of the fractional interests — including decision-making thresholds, deadlock resolution, and partition rights — shall be governed by a separate fractionalization agreement among the fractional owners. This Agreement applies to the fractional owners as a group (see **Section 2.3**), but does not prescribe the internal governance of that group. Fractional owners hold direct Beneficial Interests carrying owner-type rights — including the rights of use, possession, income, and direction described in **Section 6.1**, exercised as their fractionalization agreement provides — and not a passive expectation of profit to be derived from the managerial efforts of any promoter, platform, or third party. Neither the Trustee under this Agreement nor any platform or service provider undertakes any managerial effort on behalf of fractional owners, and no provision of this Agreement grants any platform, company, or third party any management, approval, or control right over the Trust (see **Sections 5.1 and 12.6**). Neither this Section nor **Section 11.5** determines whether a particular fractionalization agreement, offering, note, or other arrangement is a security under applicable securities law; that determination depends on the substance of the arrangement.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: While the Property Token is fractionalized across independently acting holders, no single holder may have "control" of the Property Token within the meaning of UCC Article 12, and the classification and protections described in **Sections 11.1 and 11.4** may be unavailable for the duration of that configuration; the fractional owners' rights rest during that period on this Agreement and applicable trust law, which do not depend on UCC Article 12 (**Section 11.9.2**).

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 4. **Occupancy.** The Beneficiary shall have the right — held by the Beneficiary from time to time as such, and passing with the Beneficial Interest — but not any obligation, to use and occupy the Property, or any dwelling or other habitable portion of the Property, as the Beneficiary's principal residence, rent free and without charge, except for the taxes and other costs and expenses for which the Beneficiary is responsible under **Section 6.1**, for the life of such Beneficiary or, if shorter, until the earlier of (a) the termination of such Beneficiary's beneficial ownership under **Section 7**, or (b) the termination of the Trust by an instrument or court order that describes the Property and is recorded in the real property records of the county in which the Property is located, as provided in **Section 10**. This right is permissive only: nothing in this Agreement requires occupancy or conditions any right on occupancy. This Section is intended: (i) to provide the Beneficiary the right described in Texas Property Code § 41.0021(a)(1)(C), so that Property occupied and used by a Beneficiary in the manner described in that statute may be considered the homestead of the Beneficiary under Texas Property Code § 41.0021(b) and Section 50, Article XVI, Texas Constitution, and so that analogous homestead-through-trust statutes of other jurisdictions may apply according to their terms;

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: and (ii) where a Grantor conveys Property securing an existing loan into the Trust and is and remains the Beneficiary and the occupant of the Property, to permit the transfer to qualify for the protection afforded to transfers into an inter vivos trust under the Garn-St Germain Depository Institutions Act of 1982, 12 U.S.C. § 1701j-3(d)(8), and 12 C.F.R. § 191.5(b)(1)(vi), according to their terms. This Section creates no right beyond the Owner Rights described in **Section 6.1**; it states expressly, for the benefit of lenders, taxing authorities, title insurers, and courts, the occupancy component of those rights. It neither asserts nor implies that any particular statutory protection or exemption applies to any particular Property, Beneficiary, or loan.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 1. The Beneficiary may transfer the Owner Rights by transferring the Property Token to another Account or Contract Account. When the Property Token is transferred to an Account (EOA), beneficial ownership vests in the owner of that Account upon the Transfer where the Transfer is made or authorized by the then-present Beneficiary or is otherwise given effect by this Agreement (including under **Sections 7.6 and 7.7**); a release or distribution of the Property Token by a Functional Contract vests beneficial ownership in accordance with the entitlement determined under this Agreement, and not by reason of raw receipt alone. When transferring to a Contract Account, the determination of beneficial ownership depends on the nature of the Contract Account as defined in **Section 7.3**. Upon a valid transfer of beneficial ownership through a Confirmed Transaction, the new Beneficiary will either become the new trustee or appoint the new trustee. Unless the Beneficiary has appointed a different Trustee — which appointment may be made by a signed electronic record satisfying **Section 4.1** or by any other instrument permitted by applicable law — the Beneficiary shall be deemed to be the Trustee;

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: provided, however, that in the case of a Transfer subject to **Section 7.7** (unsolicited Transfers), the transferee becomes Trustee only upon acceptance of the Beneficial Interest under **Section 7.7.4**, and until such acceptance or a valid Onchain Disclaimer the immediately prior Trustee continues in office solely with ministerial preservation authority — meaning, for every use of that phrase in this Agreement, authority to preserve the trust res and prevent waste, without power to make distributions or to direct or encumber the Property, on the pattern stated in **Section 12.6** — without liability for any act or omission during that period other than willful misconduct or, where that prior Trustee has actual knowledge of the Transfer, gross negligence. A continuing prior Trustee may resign that ministerial office by a signed record satisfying **Section 4.1**; a vacancy pending acceptance or disclaimer does not terminate the Trust, and **Sections 10.4 and 12.4** remain available. A person who lacks legal capacity to hold the office of trustee is not deemed Trustee under this Section; in that case the office is held, with the same ministerial preservation authority only, as **Section 7.6.1** provides for succession or, failing that, the office is vacant — a vacancy that does not terminate the Trust — until a Trustee with capacity is appointed under this Section, by a court under **Section 12.4**, or by the transferee's guardian, conservator, or other legal representative acting under applicable law.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
The Trustee's fiduciary duties under this Agreement run to all Beneficial Interest Holders; provided, however, that as to future and contingent Beneficial Interest Holders, such duties are limited to preserving the trust res and maintaining the integrity of the property-token relationship, and do not create any present right of action, direction, or control in any person other than the present Beneficiary (except for the narrow procedural standing described in **Sections 2.26 and 12.6**). The Trustee shall only serve as long as the Beneficiary is the Beneficiary of the Trust, and upon transfer of beneficial ownership, the prior trustee is replaced by the transferee trustee, except as **Sections 7.6.1 and 7.7** otherwise provide.

2. Transfer of the beneficial ownership of the Trust via valid transfer of the Property Token, or via a Qualified Designation under **Section 7.3(c)**, shall effectuate the full assignment of all interests, rights, duties, liabilities, and obligations under the Trust, subject, in the case of an unsolicited Transfer, to the transferee's right of disclaimer under **Section 7.7**. Therefore, use of the terms "Trustee" and "Beneficiary" within this Agreement shall reference the present Trustee and present Beneficiary, as determined by the rules set forth in this Section 7.

3. The Beneficiary may transfer custody of the Property Token to a Contract Account, which may operate in one of two ways:

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
a) As a **Smart Wallet**: a multi-signature wallet, account-abstraction wallet, or other custody solution directly controlled by specific individuals or entities. The transfer to a Smart Wallet operates as a transfer of beneficial ownership to the individual(s) or entity(ies) who control it, and they become the new Beneficiary(ies).

   b) As a **Functional Contract**: an escrow, bridge, lending protocol, collateral management system, fractionalization mechanism, or similar utility. The transfer of the Property Token to a Functional Contract does not automatically constitute a transfer of beneficial ownership. The original Beneficiary retains their Owner Rights and position as Beneficiary until either: (i) the Property Token is transferred to an Account or Smart Wallet, (ii) the Beneficiary explicitly assigns their Owner Rights through a separate legal instrument, which may be a signed electronic record satisfying **Section 4.1**, or (iii) beneficial ownership passes under a Qualified Designation as provided in **Section 7.3(c)**.

   c) **Qualified Designation: transfer of beneficial ownership during Functional Contract custody.** Beneficial ownership may change hands while the Property Token remains in the custody of one or more Functional Contracts, but only as provided in this Section 7.3(c).

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
1. A "**Qualified Designation**" means a Confirmed Transaction executed by or through one or more Functional Contracts that satisfies all of the following: (A) it consummates a sale, exchange, or other disposition of the Beneficial Interest made by, or with the authority of, the then-present Beneficiary — including by satisfying the terms on which that Beneficiary listed, offered, or committed the Property Token for sale or disposition; (B) it designates an identified person (the "**Designated Owner**") as the owner of record of the Beneficial Interest on the records of a Functional Contract — for example, as the borrower-of-record of a lending protocol whose own records entitle that person to redemption of the collateral upon repayment, to any liquidation surplus, and to control of refinancing; and (C) it is supported by Qualifying Assent Evidence of the Designated Owner as defined below. A Qualified Designation may be executed by any party — including a payment processor, relayer, or other intermediary submitting the transaction on the parties' behalf — and the identity of the transaction's sender does not determine beneficial ownership; the designation and the Qualifying Assent Evidence do.

      2. "**Qualifying Assent Evidence**" means an onchain act, or a signed electronic record, manifesting the Designated Owner's assent to take the Beneficial Interest on the terms of the designating operation. Qualifying Assent Evidence exists in each of the following cases:

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: - **(A) Initiation.** The Confirmed Transaction effecting the designation, or the operation it executes, was signed or initiated by, or upon the signed instruction of, the Designated Owner's Account or Smart Wallet, where that signature or instruction binds the terms of the operation and is evidenced on the Blockchain Network.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: - **(B) Signed record of assent.** A signed electronic record manifesting that assent, made onchain or offchain, and valid under **Section 4.1** and the statutes described in it. Any record manifesting that assent qualifies, whatever its form, wording, or medium, and by whomever captured: this Agreement prescribes no form of words, no disclosure text, and no interface, and a record made offchain in the ordinary course of the transaction (such as a purchase or checkout confirmation) qualifies without being recorded on, carried in, or referenced by any operation on the Blockchain Network. **Safe harbor.** A record under this clause (B) that (i) identifies the Property Token; (ii) identifies or objectively bounds the operation and its material economic terms; (iii) identifies or incorporates by reference this Agreement (a reference or description sufficient to locate it suffices); and (iv) states in substance that the Designated Owner's assent effects the acquisition of beneficial ownership of real property, with the incidents of that ownership, is conclusively sufficient as to its adequacy as a manifestation of assent; the absence of any of these elements does not disqualify a record that otherwise manifests assent. **Anchored records.** Where the designating operation includes a cryptographic commitment to the record, the record is presumed authentic and presumed to have been assented to as of that operation;

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
the presumption is rebuttable as between the parties to the designation, but it survives the unavailability of any platform, service, or person that captured or stored the record, the commitment itself evidencing the record's existence and timing. A record not so anchored remains fully valid. The burden of producing the record lies on the party who made, or who relies upon, the designation; if the record is not produced when the designation is questioned, the designation shall be treated as unassented as between the parties to it (legally inert under clause 5 of this Section 7.3(c), curable only under clause 2(C)), subject in every case to **Section 4.3.2** as to persons who in good faith relied on the designation. Nothing in this Agreement imposes on the Trustee, or on any platform or service provider, any duty to obtain, retain, produce, or verify any such record, and no platform or service provider is a party to a designation merely because it facilitated, transmitted, verified, or stored an operation or record.

         - **(C) Acceptance by conduct.** The Designated Owner's subsequent exercise, by a Confirmed Transaction signed or initiated by the Designated Owner's Account or Smart Wallet, of any right that the Functional Contract's records reserve to the owner of record — including repayment, refinancing, or redemption of collateral. Passive receipt or retention of a payment or distribution initiated by another party is not acceptance by conduct.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: This clause is defined by function, not by technology: any act or record satisfying its terms qualifies, under whatever technical standard it is implemented, without amendment of this Agreement.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 3. **Effect.** Upon a Qualified Designation supported by Qualifying Assent Evidence described in clause 2(A) or 2(B), beneficial ownership of the Trust and the Owner Rights pass to the Designated Owner at the Confirmed Transaction effecting the designation, notwithstanding that the Property Token remains in the custody of a Functional Contract. Where the Qualifying Assent Evidence is acceptance by conduct under clause 2(C), beneficial ownership and the Owner Rights pass to the Designated Owner upon the Confirmed Transaction constituting that acceptance, prospectively and without relation back. From the moment beneficial ownership passes: the Functional Contract's custody of the Property Token is held for the Designated Owner, and the Functional Contract's records stating that entitlement constitute an acknowledgment that control of the Property Token is held on behalf of the Designated Owner within the meaning of UCC § 12-105(e), so that the Designated Owner has control of the Property Token for purposes of UCC Article 12 and **Section 11.4** from that moment, without the acknowledgment imposing any duty on the Functional Contract or any other person (UCC § 12-105(g)); the Designated Owner is the Beneficiary for all purposes of this Agreement, including **Sections 6.1 and 12.7**; and the transferor's beneficial ownership and Owner Rights terminate simultaneously, so that at every moment exactly one present Beneficiary (or one group of fractional owners treated as the Beneficiary under **Sections 2.3 and 6.3**) holds the present Beneficial Interest.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
Upon satisfaction of the secured obligation or other termination of the Functional Contract's custody, the Functional Contract's release of the Property Token to the Designated Owner's Account or Smart Wallet confirms — and does not itself effect — the beneficial ownership already vested under this Section. A Qualified Designation is not a fractionalization of the Property Token.

      4. **Assignment instrument.** The Qualifying Assent Evidence, together with the Confirmed Transaction effecting the designation, constitutes the explicit assignment of Owner Rights described in **Section 7.3(b)(ii)**, and is a signed record satisfying **Section 4.1**. No separate offchain instrument is required.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 5. **No unilateral imposition.** A designation without Qualifying Assent Evidence is legally inert: the naming of any person as borrower-of-record or owner of record by a Functional Contract, by the sender of a transaction, or by any other party does not — by itself — transfer beneficial ownership to that person, impose on that person any duty, debt, tax attribute, or liability under **Section 6.1 or Section 12.7**, or alter the rule of **Section 7.3(b)** that custody does not confer beneficial ownership. Until Qualifying Assent Evidence exists, the prior Beneficiary's position is unchanged, except that a transferor who has received the agreed consideration under the designating operation — as evidenced by that operation or by the records produced under this Section 7.3(c) — holds their position subject to the consummated disposition and shall not exercise Owner Rights inconsistently with it. A person named without their assent may disregard the designation, and no act of theirs is required to reject it.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
6. **Scope; security.** A Qualified Designation cannot arise from mere custody: deposits, escrows, bridges, collateralization by a Beneficiary for the Beneficiary's own account (including any borrowing in which the Beneficiary is designated as their own owner of record, which effects no change of beneficial ownership), and every other Functional Contract operation not satisfying clause 1 retain exactly the treatment stated in **Section 7.3(b)**. A designation contained in, or resulting from, a Transfer or operation that itself resulted from unauthorized access to, or unauthorized use of, any Account or Smart Wallet is governed by **Section 7.5**, and a Functional Contract's records cannot validate what **Section 7.5.1** invalidates; the rights of qualifying purchasers and protected secured parties under **Section 11.4**, and of good-faith reliant parties under **Section 4.3**, are unaffected. This Section 7.3(c) is defined functionally and applies to any Functional Contract whose operation satisfies its terms; it does not depend on, or confer any status upon, any particular platform, protocol, or vendor.

   The distinction between custody and beneficial ownership ensures that temporary token operations through Functional Contracts do not unintentionally affect the underlying property rights, while preserving the flexibility to use smart contract infrastructure for property management and transfer.

All identifying information about the chain of Accounts and Contract Addresses that have interacted with the Property Token, as well as the present holding Address, are immutably recorded on the Blockchain Network(s) on which the Property Token is maintained. A platform database or other offchain record not described in this Agreement is not dispositive of beneficial ownership, and this Agreement imposes no record-keeping duty on the Trustee or on any platform or service provider.

5. Unauthorized transfers and security of access:

   1. A Transfer that is not made or authorized by the then-present Beneficiary and is not otherwise given effect by this Agreement — including a Transfer resulting from unauthorized access to the Beneficiary's Account or Smart Wallet (theft, compromise, or misappropriation of private keys or signing credentials) and a Transfer effected through the unauthorized exercise of an operator approval, delegation, or other permission previously granted by the Beneficiary — does not constitute a valid transfer of beneficial ownership under this Agreement. The prior Beneficiary retains their Owner Rights and their position as Beneficiary notwithstanding the onchain record of the Transfer.

   2. The Beneficiary is responsible for maintaining the security of access to the Account or Smart Wallet holding the Property Token.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text:
3. Nothing in this Section 7.5 limits or overrides the rights of a qualifying purchaser or protected secured party under **Section 11.4** who obtains control of the Property Token for value, in good faith, and without notice of an Adverse Claim (as defined in **Section 11.4.6**).

   4. If a claim under this Section 7.5 conflicts with a claim under **Section 11.4**, a court of competent jurisdiction as described in **Section 12.4** shall resolve the matter.

6. **Succession on Death.**

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 1. **Succession follows lawful control.** Upon the death of a Beneficiary who is a natural person, the Beneficial Interest — intangible personal property under **Section 1.4** — passes as part of the deceased Beneficiary's personal property under the law governing the deceased Beneficiary's estate (including any will, the deceased Beneficiary's own living trust or similar arrangement, intestate-succession law, and applicable community-property and survivorship rules), and the Owner Rights are exercisable by the person who lawfully succeeds to control of the Account or Smart Wallet holding or controlling the Property Token — the Key Successor (**Section 2.28**) — whether that person is an heir, a devisee, the trustee of the deceased Beneficiary's own trust, the deceased Beneficiary's executor or personal representative acting within their authority, a recovery or succession designee under the control arrangements of a Smart Wallet, or any successor the Beneficiary may designate through a signed electronic record recognized by the systems maintaining the Property Token. This Agreement recognizes the acts of the Key Successor without requiring any court order, filing, or further instrument as a condition of continuity of operation. Where the Key Successor is the person entitled to the Beneficial Interest under the law governing the estate, the Key Successor's first exercise of Owner Rights is their acceptance of the Beneficial Interest (by analogy to the acceptance rules of **Section 7.7.4**).

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: Where the Key Successor and the person so entitled are different persons, the Key Successor does not, by exercising Owner Rights, accept or acquire the Beneficial Interest: the first exercise is acceptance of a representative control function only, every exercise is made for the account of the person entitled — whom the Key Successor serves as agent and fiduciary with respect to the Beneficial Interest and, once the person entitled is ascertained and gives direction, subject to that person's direction — and only the person entitled (or an authorized representative expressly acting for that person) may accept the Beneficial Interest itself. If more than one person jointly qualifies as Key Successor under a Smart Wallet's control arrangements, they act as a group (**Sections 2.3 and 6.3**). The exercise of Owner Rights through a decedent's private keys or signing credentials by a person who is not a Key Successor is unauthorized access governed by **Section 7.5.1**. **Trustee office pending acceptance.** Upon the death of a Beneficiary, a Trustee then serving other than the deceased Beneficiary continues in office. Where the deceased Beneficiary was serving as Trustee, no person becomes Trustee by reason of the death alone:

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: until the person entitled to the Beneficial Interest accepts it (including by the Key Successor's first exercise where the Key Successor is the person entitled), the office is held — solely with the ministerial preservation authority described in **Section 7.1** — by the Key Successor if one exists and has legal capacity, and otherwise by the deceased Beneficiary's personal representative once appointed; a vacancy pending acceptance does not terminate the Trust, and upon acceptance the deemed-Trustee rule of **Section 7.1** applies to the accepting Beneficiary. Competing claims among heirs, devisees, representatives, and other successors are resolved by a court of competent jurisdiction under **Section 12.4** (or under **Section 10.4** where dissolution of the Trust is sought or required), subject to **Section 4.3.2**; the Beneficial Interest shall not be divided merely because of competing claims.

passages.title: Fabrica Trust Agreement (US)
passages.text: 2. **Personalty; no ancillary administration; process honesty.** The provisions of this Section 7.6 are provisions of a trust agreement, intended to be nontestamentary and valid without compliance with the formalities required for the execution of a will — to the extent they constitute provisions for a nonprobate transfer on death within the meaning of California Probate Code § 5000, Uniform Probate Code § 6-101 as enacted in the applicable jurisdiction, Texas Estates Code § 111.052 where the deceased Beneficiary or the Property has a Texas nexus, or any analogous statute — and independently valid as terms of an inter vivos trust. Because the Beneficial Interest is intangible personal property (**Section 1.4**), its succession is governed by the law governing the decedent's intangible personal property — ordinarily the law of the decedent's domicile — and the location of the Property does not, of itself, subject the Beneficial Interest to ancillary administration in the jurisdiction where the Property is located; the proof-of-succession requirements of **Section 10.3.2** are evidentiary conditions of recording a deed out of the Trust, not a condition of succession to the Beneficial Interest and not an ancillary administration of it. This Section does not purport to eliminate probate or estate administration where the law governing the estate requires it; it ensures that administration never interrupts the operation of the Trust (**Section 7.6.1**).
